title: Divide without a divide op
starter:
%a = param [] slot=0 dtype=f32 addrspace=ALU
%b = param [] slot=1 dtype=f32 addrspace=ALU
%out = mul %a %b
hints: The starter multiplies `%a` by `%b`. Dividing by `%b` is multiplying by one over `%b`.
`recip %b` is `1 / b`. Give it its own line and its own name.
Add the line `%r = recip %b` and change the last line to `%out = mul %a %r`.

answer.code:
%a = param [] slot=0 dtype=f32 addrspace=ALU
%b = param [] slot=1 dtype=f32 addrspace=ALU
%r = recip %b
%out = mul %a %r
answer.explain: There is no f32 division op, so `a / b` is written `mul %a %r` with `%r = recip %b`. When `b` is `0.0` the reciprocal is `inf`, so `-5.0 / 0.0` is `-inf`, and `0.0 * inf` has no sensible answer, so `0.0 / 0.0` is `nan`. Nothing is rejected and nothing fails while running.
